ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Al-Kawthar in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, Al-Kawthar is often interpreted as a specific, eternal abundance granted to the Prophet Muhammad and, by extension, his progeny, the Ahl al-Bayt, serving as a divine counter to the lineage extinction feared by his Quraysh critics. This verse not only consoles the Prophet but also establishes the spiritual and material prosperity of his family as a sign of his prophethood, linking the concept of 'goodness' directly to the Imams.
